title: The Rashomon Effect for Visualizing High-Dimensional Data
abstract: arXiv:2604.00485v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Dimension reduction (DR) is inherently non-unique: multiple embeddings can preserve the structure of high-dimensional data equally well while differing in layout or geometry. In this paper, we formally define the Rashomon set for DR -- the collection of `good' embedding -- and show how embracing this multiplicity leads to more powerful and trustworthy representations. Specifically, we pursue three goals. First, we introduce PCA-informed alignment to steer embeddings toward principal components, making axes interpretable without distorting local neighborhoods. Second, we design concept-alignment regularization that aligns an embedding dimension with external knowledge, such as class labels or user-defined concepts. translated_title: 高维数据可视化的拉什莫效应
translated_abstract: 维度缩减（DR）本质上不是唯一的：多个嵌入可以同样好地保留高维数据的结构，但在布局或几何形状上却有所不同。在本文中，我们正式定义了DR的拉什莫集——即“良好”嵌入的集合——并展示了拥抱这种多样性如何导致更强大和更可信的表示。具体而言，我们追求三个目标。首先，我们引入基于PCA的对齐方法，将嵌入引导至主成分方向，使轴可解释而不扭曲局部邻域。其次，我们设计概念对齐正则化，将嵌入维度与外部知识（如类标签或用户定义的概念）对齐。第三，我们提出一种方法，通过识别可信且持久的最近邻关系来提取拉什莫集中的共同知识，并用此构建具有改进局部结构的细化嵌入。
tldr: 本文定义了高维数据降维的拉什莫集，并提出了基于PCA和概念对齐的正则化方法及提取共同知识的技术，以增强嵌入的可解释性和可信度。
en_tdlr: This paper defines the Rashomon set for dimensionality reduction and proposes PCA-informed alignment, concept-alignment regularization, and common knowledge extraction to enhance interpretability and trustworthiness of embeddings.
